content: Leg day: squats 5x5 at 80kg, then Romanian deadlifts. Knees felt fine.
Bench press PR, 62.5kg for three. Rest longer between sets next time.
Rowing machine 2k in 7:58, then pull-ups and core work.
Deload week: everything at 70 percent, focus on form for the squat.
New programme from the coach: three sessions a week, upper and lower split.
Pasta with garlic, chilli and lemon, serves two, twenty minutes.
Banana bread: three ripe bananas, flour, sugar, bake 50 minutes at 180.
Lemon chicken traybake with potatoes, garlic and thyme.
Sourdough starter fed with rye flour; bake the loaf on Saturday morning.
Dal: red lentils, cumin, turmeric, a tin of tomatoes, simmer half an hour.
Standup: the launch date moves to the 21st, Priya owns the release notes.
Quarterly planning with the team, three priorities for the roadmap.
Client call with Riverside: they want the export feature before renewal.
Hiring: two backend engineers, interviews start next week with the panel.
Retro notes: the deploy pipeline was slow, fix the flaky tests in CI.
Lisbon trip: hotel booked near the river for three nights in May.
Train from Lisbon to Porto takes about three hours, book seats early.
Packing list for Portugal: walking shoes, adapter, light jacket, passport.
Flights to Edinburgh on the evening plane, seats 14A and 14B.
Day trip to Sintra from Lisbon by train, the palace opens at nine.
Dentist check-up booked for the 21st, ask about the night guard.
GP says blood pressure is fine, recheck in six months.
Physio for the shoulder: band exercises twice a day, ice after.
Sleep has been poor this week, no screens after ten and less coffee.
Prescription renewal due, the pharmacy needs the doctor's sign-off.
Budget for October: rent, groceries 400, savings transfer on payday.
Tax return lodged, the refund should arrive in about three weeks.
Switch the energy supplier, the fixed tariff saves about 20 a month.
Pension contribution raised to 8 percent from next month's salary.
Car insurance renewal quote went up, compare three other providers.
Thinking in Systems: stocks and flows, a feedback loop needs a delay.
Finished The Remains of the Day, the butler's restraint is the whole book.
Next on the reading list: Middlemarch, then a book on the history of maps.
Book club picked Piranesi for November, chapters one to six first.
Underlined in Four Thousand Weeks: attention is the life you lead.
Boiler service due in March, call the plumber about the pressure drop.
Paint the hallway: two coats of the pale green, buy new rollers.
The garage door opener works with the blue remote but not the grey one.
Garden: compost the leaves, plant the tulip bulbs before the frost.
Washing machine leaks at the door seal, order a replacement gasket.
Photo: new PB on the rower board, 7:41 for the 2k.
My legs after Bulgarian split squats: retired, do not contact.
From the coach's email: "Keep the RPE around 7 this block. If the bar slows down on the last rep, stop the set there. We'll test maxes in week six."
Gym bag: chalk, lifting belt, knee sleeves, towel, padlock.
Skipped Thursday's session, back on Saturday for pull day.
Loaf 6: 78% hydration, shaped too early, crumb was tight.
Recipe from Nonna's card: 500 g tipo 00, 5 eggs, a pinch of salt. Rest the dough under a bowl for thirty minutes before rolling it thin.
I set the smoke alarm off again, so dinner is officially cajun.
Pic: the shakshuka before the eggs went in.
Shopping for the curry: coconut milk, ginger, coriander, basmati.
Harbor launch plan: ship the mobile app by the end of the quarter, marketing site the week after.
Meeting with Priya about pricing: two tiers, annual discount, decide by Friday.
Pasted from Slack: "Heads up, the staging database is being migrated tonight at 22:00, expect fifteen minutes of downtime. Ping #infra if anything looks off."
My calendar has four meetings about reducing meetings.
Performance review prep: shipped billing v2, mentored two juniors, led the incident review.
Flight to Lisbon, hotel in Porto, car hire for the Douro valley.
Photo: sunrise from the night train window somewhere near Vienna.
Booking confirmation: Hotel Arosa, check-in 15:00, check-out 11:00, reservation 48213, breakfast included.
Airport rule: the gate is always the furthest one from security.
Japan itinerary: Tokyo four nights, Kyoto three, Osaka two, rail pass for the week.
Therapy session: we talked about the panic attacks before presentations, try box breathing.
Blood test results back, iron is low, start the supplements and retest in three months.
Discharge note: "Mild concussion. Rest for 48 hours, no screens, return if vomiting or confusion."
Sleep: screens off at 10:30, alarm at 6:45, no coffee after two.
The optician asked me to read the bottom line. I asked which one.
Credit card debt down to 2,300, pay 300 a month and it's gone by summer.
Statement summary: opening balance 1,842.10, direct debits 912.40, closing balance 2,115.77.
Subscriptions to cancel: streaming bundle, the unused language app, cloud storage tier two.
My bank sent a fraud alert because I bought vegetables.
Mortgage fix ends in April, book a call with the broker in January.
Essay about cutting sentences: Orwell's rule of never using a long word where a short one will do.
Photo of the shelf: all the Le Guin paperbacks finally together.
Quote from Middlemarch: "What do we live for, if it is not to make life less difficult to each other?"
Bought another book to read about why I don't finish books.
Library holds: Klara and the Sun, The Overstory, Braiding Sweetgrass.
Boiler pressure dropped to 0.5 again, topped it up to 1.2.
Before the inspection: fix the bathroom fan, patch the hole by the door, clean the oven.
From the landlord: "An electrician will check the smoke alarms on Tuesday between 9 and 12, please make sure someone is in."
Pic: damp patch above the bedroom window, measured 30 cm across.
The flat-pack wardrobe came with two spare screws, which is worrying.
Watched Dune part two, the sandworm ride is worth the cinema ticket.
Severance season two: finished episode four, the corridor scene.
Screenshot from Paddington 2: the marmalade scene.
To watch: Past Lives, Perfect Days, The Zone of Interest.
Started a documentary about sloths and fell asleep first.
My review: "Slow in the best way. Every frame of Aftersun is a memory you are not sure happened." Four and a half stars.
Film night Friday: Alien, then Aliens if we're still awake.
The Bear series three felt like a cooking show without the plot.
Rewatching The Office with subtitles on, the jokes land better.
Oscar picks: Anora for best picture, the cinematography award to The Brutalist.
Mum's birthday on the 12th, book the restaurant and ask Tom about the card.
Ella's school play is Thursday at six, she is a tree with two lines.
Hard conversation with Dad about moving into assisted living. He's scared of losing the house.
Photo: Grandma teaching the twins to make dumplings.
Leo asked if I was alive when the dinosaurs were. Then he asked about the internet.
Sunday call with my sister, she's thinking of moving back from Leeds.
Six months since Grandad died. Visited the grave with Mum, she wants to plant roses there.
Christmas presents: Lego for Leo, a sketchbook for Ella, slippers for Dad.
Message from the nursery: "Reminder that pickup is at 5:30 sharp on Friday because of staff training."
Ella lost her first tooth, the tooth fairy rate is apparently two pounds now.
Lecture 7 on thermodynamics: entropy always increases in a closed system.
Essay due on the 14th: 2,000 words on the causes of the First World War.
Study plan for exams: two past papers a day, the library from nine.
From the module handbook: "Coursework is worth 40% of the final mark. Late submissions lose 5% per day."
The professor said the exam would be easy. The professor lied.
Group project meeting in the library, Sam is doing the slides.
Photo of the whiteboard after the linear algebra tutorial.
Office hours with Dr Okafor, ask about the dissertation topic.
Semester two modules: organic chemistry, statistics, lab skills.
Seminar reading for Tuesday: chapter three of the methods book.
MOT due on the 3rd, the tyres are close to the legal limit.
Car making a grinding noise when braking, book the garage.
Oil change at 45,000 miles, next one at 55,000.
Photo: the dent on the rear bumper from the car park.
The check engine light is just the car asking how my day is.
Garage invoice: front brake pads and discs, labour 1.5 h, total 286.40.
Road trip kit: jump leads, warning triangle, spare bulbs, de-icer.
Tyre pressure 36 front, 34 rear, checked at the petrol station.
Parking permit renewal for the street, the council site wants the V5C.
Test drove the electric hatchback, range about 250 miles in winter.
